some roasted goat meat and presented it to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ took a foreleg of the goat and started eating it while a group of Sahabah (RA) also joined him. Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "Take your hands off (the food)!" Rasulullaah ﷺ then sent for the woman and when she arrived, her asked, "Did you poison this meat?" "Who told you about it?" she asked. Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "This (foreleg) here in my hand informed me." When she admitted that she did poison the meat, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked her why she did it. She replied, "I said to myself that it would do you no harm if you really are a Rasul and if you are not, we would be rid of you." Rasulullaah ﷺ forgave her and did not punish her.
However, some of the Sahabah (RA) who had eaten from the meat passed away and because he had also eaten from it, Rasulullaah ﷺ had blood cupped from his shoulder. Hadhrat Abu Hind (RA) who was a freed slave of the Ansaar Banu Bayaadha tribe did the cupping using a horn and a blade. Another narration from Hadhrat Abu Salamah (RA) states that Hadhrat Bishr bin Baraa bin Ma'roor (RA) passed away (from the poisoning). The narration further states that (because of this death) Rasulullaah ﷺ then had the woman executed.[^1]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Marwaan bin Uthmaan bin Abu Sa'eed bin Mu'allaa (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Marwaan bin Uthmaan bin Abu Sa'eed bin Mu'allaa (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ was on his deathbed, the sister of Hadhrat Bishr bin Baraa bin Ma'roor (RA) came to visit him. Rasulullaah ﷺ said to her, "O Ummu Bishr! I can now feel my arteries shredding because of what I ate with your brother in Khaybar." (Because of this) Muslims believe that together with the mantle of Nabuwaat, Allaah also blessed Rasulullaah ﷺ with the mantle of martyrdom.[^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Expressed Tolerance towards a Man who Wished to Assassinate him

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Ja'da bin Khaalid bin Simmah Jushami (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Ja'da bin Khaalid bin Simmah Jushami (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once saw a man with a large belly and pointed towards the man's belly. Hadhrat Ja'da (RA) then heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, "It would have been better for you if that had been somewhere else (if you had spent on those without food rather than gorging yourself)." Thereafter, a man was brought and Rasulullaah ﷺ was informed that the man had intended to assassinate Rasulullaah ﷺ. "There is nothing to be feared," Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Had you tried it, Allaah would have never given you power over me."[^3]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Behaves Tolerantly Towards a Party of the Quraysh who Planned an Ambush
